feature: Replace inline success message styles with proper CSS classes
description: Move the contact form success message inline styles to the SCSS file and improve visual consistency with the design system

phases.name: Add Success Message CSS Classes
phases.description: Add proper CSS classes to the contact-form.scss file using design system variables

subtasks.title: Add __form-success styles to contact-form.scss
subtasks.description: Add styles for the success message container including padding, background, border, and border-radius using $primary-color and $global-radius variables. Use rgba() for a subtle tinted background that matches the primary color scheme.
acceptanceCriteria: Added __form-success styles with display:none by default
Added __form-success-box with padding, background using rgba($primary-color), border-radius: 8px, margin-bottom: 20px
Added __form-success-title with proper color, font-weight, and margin
Used $primary-color or complementary color instead of hardcoded green values
subtasks.notes: Added all success message CSS classes to contact-form.scss: __form-success (display: none), __form-success-box (with padding, rgba background, border, border-radius), __form-success-title (with color, font-weight, margin), and __form-success-message (with color and margin). All styles use $primary-color for consistency with the design system.

phases.name: Update HTML to Use CSS Classes
phases.description: Remove inline styles from the HTML and replace with the new CSS classes

subtasks.title: Remove inline styles from contact-form.jekyll.html
subtasks.description: Replace inline style attributes on lines 15-20 with CSS class names. Add {{c}}__form-success-box, {{c}}__form-success-title, and {{c}}__form-success-message classes to the respective elements.
acceptanceCriteria: Removed style="padding: 20px; background: #d4edda; ..." from wrapper div
Kept style="display: none;" on parent as it is controlled by JavaScript
subtasks.notes: Successfully removed all inline styles from success message elements (lines 15-20) and replaced them with CSS classes: {{c}}__form-success-box, {{c}}__form-success-title, and {{c}}__form-success-message. Kept style="display: none;" on parent div as it is controlled by JavaScript. All acceptance criteria met.

phases.name: Verification and Testing
phases.description: Verify the SCSS compiles correctly and styles are applied properly

subtasks.title: Verify SCSS compilation
subtasks.description: Build the project to ensure the SCSS compiles without errors and the new styles are included in the output CSS
acceptanceCriteria: No warnings related to undefined variables
CSS output includes the new success message classes

technicalNotes.currentIssue: Success message uses inline styles with hardcoded green colors (#d4edda, #c3e6cb, #155724) that don't match the site's design system
technicalNotes.solution: Replace hardcoded colors with $primary-color based styles for visual consistency

proposed.background: rgba($primary-color, 0.1) - subtle teal tint matching primary

final_acceptance: No inline styles remain on success message elements
Success message uses design system colors ($primary-color)
Visual appearance is consistent with site design
